# Footnotes

```````````````````````````````` example
none [^1]
.
<p>none [^1]</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
oneline [^1]

[^1]: foo
.
<p>oneline <sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup></p>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>foo<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
multiple lines [^1]

[^1]: foo

 one

  two

   three

    four

     five
.
<p>multiple lines <sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup></p>
<pre><code> five</code></pre>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>foo</p>
<p>one</p>
<p>two</p>
<p>three</p>
<p>four<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
multi-line footnote[^1]

[^1]:
    Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod
    tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam,
    quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo
    consequat. Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse
    cillum dolore eu fugiat nulla pariatur. Excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat
    non proident, sunt in culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum.
.
<p>multi-line footnote<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup></p>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod
tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam,
quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo
consequat. Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse
cillum dolore eu fugiat nulla pariatur. Excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat
non proident, sunt in culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum.<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
fenced code block in footnote[^1]

[^1]:
    first

    ```sh
    second
    third
    ```

    fourth
.
<p>fenced code block in footnote<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup></p>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>first</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">second
third
</code></pre>
<p>fourth<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

https://github.com/lepture/mistune/issues/378

```````````````````````````````` example
This is a foo [^foo].

This is a bar [^bar].

[^foo]: A foo is beautiful. This is in contrast to a bar [^bar].

[^bar]: A bar is very common.
.
<p>This is a foo <sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup>.</p>
<p>This is a bar <sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-2"><a href="#fn-2">2</a></sup>.</p>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>A foo is beautiful. This is in contrast to a bar <sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-2-2"><a href="#fn-2">2</a></sup>.<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
<li id="fn-2"><p>A bar is very common.<a href="#fnref-2" class="footnote">&#8617;</a><a href="#fnref-2-2" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

https://github.com/lepture/mistune/issues/378

```````````````````````````````` example
This is body text, and a footnote.[^f]

[^f]: The footnote includes [a link][1].

[1]: https://example.com
.
<p>This is body text, and a footnote.<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup></p>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>The footnote includes <a href="https://example.com">a link</a>.<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

https://github.com/lepture/mistune/issues/428

```````````````````````````````` example
paragraph [^fn]
[^fn]: *emph*
  > aaa
.
<p>paragraph <sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup></p>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p><em>emph</em></p>
<blockquote>
<p>aaa</p>
</blockquote>
<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
First[^a] and second[^a].

[^a]: Note.
.
<p>First<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup> and second<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1-2"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup>.</p>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>Note.<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a><a href="#fnref-1-2" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
One[^x], two[^x], three[^x].

[^x]: Shared.
.
<p>One<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup>, two<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1-2"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup>, three<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1-3"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup>.</p>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>Shared.<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a><a href="#fnref-1-2" class="footnote">&#8617;</a><a href="#fnref-1-3" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
A[^a] B[^b] C[^a] D[^b].

[^a]: A note.

[^b]: B note.
.
<p>A<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup> B<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-2"><a href="#fn-2">2</a></sup> C<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1-2"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup> D<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-2-2"><a href="#fn-2">2</a></sup>.</p>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>A note.<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a><a href="#fnref-1-2" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
<li id="fn-2"><p>B note.<a href="#fnref-2" class="footnote">&#8617;</a><a href="#fnref-2-2" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
- item[^a]
- again[^a]

[^a]: Listed.
.
<ul>
<li>item<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup></li>
<li>again<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1-2"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup></li>
</ul>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>Listed.<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a><a href="#fnref-1-2" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
# Title[^a]

More[^a].

[^a]: Head note.
.
<h1>Title<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup></h1>
<p>More<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1-2"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup>.</p>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>Head note.<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a><a href="#fnref-1-2" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
See[^z] and again[^z].

[^z]: Defined once.
.
<p>See<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup> and again<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1-2"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup>.</p>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>Defined once.<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a><a href="#fnref-1-2" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
none [^missing] and [^missing] again.
.
<p>none [^missing] and [^missing] again.</p>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
Use[^b] then[^a].

[^a]: Second defined.

[^b]: First defined.
.
<p>Use<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup> then<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-2"><a href="#fn-2">2</a></sup>.</p>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>First defined.<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
<li id="fn-2"><p>Second defined.<a href="#fnref-2" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
Text[^a]. More[^a].

[^a]: First para.

    Second para.
.
<p>Text<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup>. More<sup class="footnote-ref" id="fnref-1-2"><a href="#fn-1">1</a></sup>.</p>
<section class="footnotes">
<ol>
<li id="fn-1"><p>First para.</p>
<p>Second para.<a href="#fnref-1" class="footnote">&#8617;</a><a href="#fnref-1-2" class="footnote">&#8617;</a></p></li>
</ol>
</section>
````````````````````````````````
